hero.headline: Building software. Making ideas clear.
hero.summary: I'm an IT student and developer in Ho Chi Minh City, with experience in Python and Prolog research, full-stack applications, and technical writing.

biography: I'm Huynh Phuong Dai, also known as Harry Huynh. My background brings together software development, research, and teaching. I enjoy getting to know an unfamiliar system, building something useful with it, and making the work understandable to others.

During my R&D internship at Titan Technology Corporation, I worked with Python, Prolog, and the Popper inductive logic programming library. My contributions included a command-line interface, a React and Flask application, development tools, documentation, and CI/CD workflows with unit tests.

At university, I led a nine-person team building a student-records web application and worked on database design and technical documentation. Alongside my studies, teaching English and robotics has helped me explain complicated ideas in a way people can use.
principles: Leave useful documentation for the next person.
Communicate clearly, especially when working as a team.

experience.summary: Researched and developed a full-stack product using Popper inductive logic programming, Python, and Prolog.
achievements: Built a CLI for running ILP from user input and designed a React and Flask interface.
Investigated the ILP library's architecture and created development tools and technical documentation.
Managed GitLab merge requests and conflicts, and designed CI/CD workflows with unit tests.

experience.summary: Taught academic English to working adults, with more than 300 hours of teaching experience.
achievements: Helped learners prepare for IELTS exams.
Delivered lessons in presentations, public speaking, and improvisation based on learner needs.

experience.summary: Led a nine-person team through an 11-week web application project for displaying and visualizing academic data.
achievements: Coordinated the project's technical direction, meetings, and documentation.
Conducted feasibility studies and risk assessments, and worked with stakeholders.

experience.summary: Designed and optimized a database structure while documenting its development.
achievements: Created technical documents and recorded the development process.

experience.summary: Contributed to a multi-university research project on integrating AI into medical processes.
achievements: Collaborated with Thu Duc Hospital's board of medicine as part of the research program.

experience.summary: Helped secondary-school students learn to program LEGO MINDSTORMS robots.
achievements: Explained programming concepts through practical robotics activities.
